items.headline: Wind Advisory issued July 10 at 10:55AM AKDT until July 11 at 7:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...South winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 50 mph expected.

* WHERE...Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims Camp.

* WHEN...From 10 AM to 7 PM AKDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Recent
rainfall has loosened soil and root systems, which could lead to
downed trees and a few power outages.
items.areas: Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims Camp
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued July 10 at 10:55AM AKDT until July 11 at 10:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southwest winds 25 to 35 mph with gusts up to 60 mph
expected.

* WHERE...Northern Denali Borough.

* WHEN...From 10 AM to 10 PM AKDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

items.headline: Heat Advisory issued July 10 at 10:55AM AKDT until July 11 at 11:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Hot temperatures as high as 85 degrees expected.

* WHERE...Yukon Flats.

* WHEN...Until 11 PM AKDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Individuals not accustomed to these unusually hot
temperatures for this region may experience heat related illnesses.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...The warmest temperatures will be away from
the Yukon River.
items.instruction:
Drink plenty of fluids and check up on elderly and vulnerable
relatives and neighbors.

Take extra precautions when working in the sun. Wear sunscreen and
lightweight, loose fitting clothing. Try to limit strenuous

items.headline: Red Flag Warning issued July 10 at 9:09AM AKDT until July 11 at 7:00PM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
The National Weather Service in Anchorage has issued a Red Flag
Warning FOR HOT DRY AND WINDY CONDITIONS, which is in effect from
noon to 7 PM AKDT Saturday.

* Winds...Southeast 15 to 25 mph. Gusts up to 40 mph.

* Timing...Hot, dry, windy conditions expected to begin by noon,
persisting into the evening, as temperatures cool by 7pm.

* Relative Humidity...As low as 20 percent.

* Temperatures...In the lower to mid 70s for lower elevations.

* Location...Areas along the Copper and Chitina River
items.areas: Central Copper Valley; Southern Copper Valley; McCarthy
items.instruction:
A red flag warning means that critical fire weather conditions
are imminent or occurring now, or will shortly. It is directed
toward fire agencies, and through them to the public.

items.instruction:
A Red Flag Warning means that conditions are occurring or will
occur which could lead to the development of large and dangerous
fires. It is directed toward fire agencies, and through them, to
the public.

Please advise the appropriate officials or fire crews in the
field of this Red Flag Warning.
